name: Premiumize.me
description: Generate file links using your Premiumize.me account. Open the service website and save its API key in this plugin's Settings first. Service availability and fair-use limits apply.

files.common.lua:
-- Shared by the three separately packaged plugins. No account information is logged.
local M = {}
function M.text(value, label, limit)
  assert(type(value) == "string" and #value > 0 and #value <= (limit or 2048), "Invalid " .. label .. " in service response")
  assert(not value:find("[%c]"), "Invalid " .. label .. " in service response")
  return value
end
function M.session(origin, token)
  local headers = { Accept = "application/json" }
  if token then headers.Authorization = "Bearer " .. M.text(token, "access token") end
  -- Origin-bound sessions refuse cross-origin redirects, including credentials
  -- embedded in POST bodies or device-code query parameters.
  return xd.http_session(origin, { headers = headers })
end
function M.request(session, url, fields)
  local options = { session = session }
  if fields then
    local keys, parts = {}, {}
    for key in pairs(fields) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys)
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do parts[#parts + 1] = xd.url_encode(key) .. "=" .. xd.url_encode(tostring(fields[key])) end
    options.method = "POST"
    options.body = table.concat(parts, "&")
    options.headers = { ["Content-Type"] = "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" }
  end
  local ok, reply = pcall(xd.fetch, url, options)
  assert(ok, "Cannot reach the service. Check your connection or proxy, then try again.")
  if reply.status == 429 then error("The service is limiting requests. Wait before trying again.") end
  if reply.status >= 500 then error("The service is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.") end
  local parsed, data = pcall(xd.json, reply.body)
  assert(parsed and type(data) == "table", "The service returned an unreadable response.")
  return data, reply.status
end
function M.account()
  local saved = xd.setting("account")
  assert(type(saved) == "string" and #saved > 0, "Connect your account first.")
  local ok, data = pcall(xd.json, saved)
  assert(ok and type(data) == "table", "Saved account is invalid. Connect again.")
  return data
end
function M.save(data)
  xd.save_secret("account", xd.to_json(data))
end
function M.status(title)
  return { title = title, items = {} }
end
function M.item(link, filename, size, domains)
  M.text(link, "download link", 16384)
  local host = link:match("^https?://([^/?#]+)")
  assert(host and not host:find("[@:]"), "The service returned an unsupported download address.")
  host = host:lower()
  local allowed = false
  for _, domain in ipairs(domains) do
    if host == domain or host:sub(-#domain - 1) == "." .. domain then allowed = true end
  end
  assert(allowed, "The service returned an unapproved download host. Report this on GitHub without sharing the private link.")
  if filename ~= nil then M.text(filename, "filename", 1024) end
  if type(size) ~= "number" or size <= 0 or size > 9007199254740991 then size = nil end
  return { kind = "file", url = link, filename = filename, size = size }
end
function M.disconnect()
  xd.save_secret("account", nil)
  return M.status("Disconnected. This app's saved account has been removed.")
end
return M
files.main.lua:
local h = require("common")
local origin = "https://www.premiumize.me"
local errors = {
  authentication_failed = "The API key is missing, invalid or expired. Save a new key in this plugin's Settings.",
  permission_denied = "Premiumize denied this request. Check your account on its website.",
  service_unsupported = "Premiumize does not support this source.",
  not_found = "This file is no longer available.",
  service_down = "This host is temporarily unavailable.",
  service_limit_reached = "Your account's allowance for this host has been used.",
  account_limit_reached = "Your Premiumize fair-use allowance has been used.",
  rate_limit_reached = "The service is limiting requests. Try again later.",
  link_generation_failed = "Premiumize could not generate this link yet. Try again later.",
}
if xd.extension.job == "disconnect" then return h.disconnect() end
local key = xd.setting("account")
assert(type(key) == "string" and #key > 0,
  "Open the service website, copy your API key, then save it in this plugin's Settings.")
local session = h.session(origin, key)
local function request(path, fields)
  local data, status = h.request(session, origin .. "/api/" .. path, fields)
  assert(status < 400 and data.status == "success",
    errors[data.code] or "Premiumize refused this request. Check your account and source availability on its website.")
  return data
end
if xd.extension.job == "connect" or xd.extension.job == "account" then
  local account = request("account/info")
  assert(type(account.customer_id) == "string" or type(account.customer_id) == "number",
    "Premiumize returned incomplete account details.")
  -- Do not infer that an account is currently premium from an expiry timestamp
  -- alone, or persist identifiers and personal account data.
  local title = "Premiumize.me connected."
  if type(account.limit_used) == "number" and account.limit_used >= 0 and account.limit_used <= 1 then
    title = title .. " Fair-use allowance used: " .. math.floor(account.limit_used * 100) .. "%."
  end
  return h.status(title)
end
assert(xd.extension.job == "generate", "Unknown plugin action.")
local response = request("transfer/directdl", { src = event.url })
assert(type(response.content) == "table", "Premiumize did not return a file list.")
local items, names = {}, {}
for _, file in ipairs(response.content) do
  assert(#items < 1000, "The service returned too many links.")
  local path = h.text(file.path, "file path", 1024)
  local name = path:match("[^/\\]+$")
  assert(name and name ~= "." and name ~= "..", "Invalid generated filename.")
  -- All files go through the ordinary destination review, never service paths.
  local original, number = name, 2
  while names[name:lower()] do
    local stem, suffix = original:match("^(.*)(%.[^.]*)$")
    name = (stem or original) .. " (" .. number .. ")" .. (suffix or "")
    number = number + 1
  end
  names[name:lower()] = true
  items[#items + 1] = h.item(file.link, name, file.size, { "premiumize.me", "energycdn.com" })
end
assert(#items > 0, "Premiumize did not return a downloadable file. The source may not be ready for direct download.")
return { title = "Premiumize.me — generated downloads", single_connection = true, items = items }
